summary: Cycurion, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a merger agreement to acquire Secuvant, LLC via a reverse merger where Cycurion's wholly owned Merger Sub will merge into Secuvant, leaving Secuvant as a surviving wholly owned subsidiary. Total consideration is ~$2.875M, comprising $875,000 in cash (paid in installments at closing and 60/120 days later, subject to working capital adjustment) and 888,888 shares of Series I Convertible Preferred Stock valued at $2.0M, issued in five tranches with vesting tied to stock price and volume thresholds. Target equityholders also receive a guaranteed $100k/year earn-out for three years. The structure aligns incentives via performance-based vesting. Watch for regulatory clearance, stock price performance for vesting, and working capital adjustment impact.
